SELECT COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, SUM(CASE WHEN w.task_type='BOOKKEEPING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bookkeeping, SUM(CASE WHEN w.task_type='RENEWAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS renewal, SUM(CASE WHEN w.task_type='FIELD_WORK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fieldwork, SUM(CASE WHEN w.task_type='DATA_COLLECTION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS data_collection, COUNT(*) AS total FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 WHERE w.deleted=0 AND w.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND w.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','WAITING_CHILD','SUSPENDED')
AND (w.current_owner_user IN #{x} OR (w.current_owner_user IS NULL AND w.owner_user IN #{x})) GROUP BY COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, COUNT(*) AS overdue_count, MAX(DATEDIFF(#{now}, w.due_time)) AS max_days FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 WHERE w.deleted=0 AND w.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND w.due_time IS NOT NULL AND w.due_time < #{now} AND w.status NOT IN ('DONE','CANCELED')
AND (w.current_owner_user IN #{x} OR (w.current_owner_user IS NULL AND w.owner_user IN #{x})) GROUP BY COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) ORDER BY overdue_count DESC

SELECT w.id AS work_order_id, w.task_no AS task_no, w.title AS title, w.task_type AS task_type, COALESCE(w.current_owner_name, w.owner_user_name) AS owner_name, DATEDIFF(#{now}, w.due_time) AS overdue_days FROM work_order w WHERE w.deleted=0 AND w.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND w.due_time IS NOT NULL AND w.due_time < #{now} AND w.status NOT IN ('DONE','CANCELED')
AND (w.current_owner_user IN #{x} OR (w.current_owner_user IS NULL AND w.owner_user IN #{x})) ORDER BY overdue_days DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, SUM(CASE WHEN w.update_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 6 DAY AND w.update_time < NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count3, SUM(CASE WHEN w.update_time < NOW() - INTERVAL 6 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count7 FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 WHERE w.deleted=0 AND w.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND w.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','WAITING_CHILD','SUSPENDED')
AND (w.current_owner_user IN #{x} OR (w.current_owner_user IS NULL AND w.owner_user IN #{x})) GROUP BY COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) HAVING (count3+count7) > 0 ORDER BY count7 DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN cs.end_date >= #{today} AND cs.end_date < #{plus1m} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bucket1m, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.end_date >= #{plus1m} AND cs.end_date < #{plus2m} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bucket2m, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.end_date >= #{plus2m} AND cs.end_date < #{plus3m} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bucket3m, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.end_date >= #{today} AND cs.end_date < #{plus2m} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within2m, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.end_date >= #{today} AND cs.end_date < #{plus3m} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within3m FROM company_service cs JOIN sys_business sb ON sb.id = cs.business_id AND sb.deleted = 0 WHERE cs.deleted = 0 AND (cs.status IS NULL OR cs.status = 'ACTIVE') AND sb.business_name IN ('代账报税-正式', '代账报税-体验') AND cs.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cs.butler_owner_user IN #{x}

SELECT cs.butler_owner_user AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.end_date >= #{today} AND cs.end_date < #{plus1m} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bucket1m, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.end_date >= #{plus1m} AND cs.end_date < #{plus2m} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bucket2m, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.end_date >= #{plus2m} AND cs.end_date < #{plus3m} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bucket3m, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.end_date >= #{today} AND cs.end_date < #{plus2m} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within2m, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.end_date >= #{today} AND cs.end_date < #{plus3m} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within3m FROM company_service cs JOIN sys_business sb ON sb.id = cs.business_id AND sb.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username = cs.butler_owner_user AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE cs.deleted = 0 AND (cs.status IS NULL OR cs.status = 'ACTIVE') AND sb.business_name IN ('代账报税-正式', '代账报税-体验') AND cs.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cs.end_date >= #{today} AND cs.end_date < #{plus3m} AND cs.butler_owner_user IN #{x} GROUP BY cs.butler_owner_user HAVING within3m > 0 ORDER BY within2m DESC, bucket1m DESC

SELECT cs.butler_owner_user AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.company_id) AS total_companies, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bsu.id IS NOT NULL THEN cs.company_id END) AS done_companies, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bsu.id IS NOT NULL THEN cs.company_id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT cs.company_id), 0), 2) AS rate FROM company_service cs LEFT JOIN company_bank_statement_upload bsu ON bsu.company_id=cs.company_id AND bsu.period=#{period} AND (COALESCE(bsu.upload_count,0) > 0 OR COALESCE(bsu.no_statement,0)=1) LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=cs.butler_owner_user AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 WHERE cs.deleted=0 AND cs.butler_owner_user IN #{x} GROUP BY cs.butler_owner_user HAVING total_companies > 0 ORDER BY rate DESC

SELECT COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, COUNT(*) AS active_count FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 WHERE w.deleted=0 AND w.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND w.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','WAITING_CHILD','SUSPENDED')
AND (w.current_owner_user IN #{x} OR (w.current_owner_user IS NULL AND w.owner_user IN #{x})) GROUP BY COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) ORDER BY active_count DESC

SELECT w.status AS stage, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, w.update_time, NOW())), 1) AS avg_hours, SUM(CASE WHEN w.update_time <= NOW() - INTERVAL 72 HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_tail_count FROM work_order w WHERE w.deleted=0 AND w.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND w.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','WAITING_CHILD','SUSPENDED')
AND (w.current_owner_user IN #{x} OR (w.current_owner_user IS NULL AND w.owner_user IN #{x})) GROUP BY w.status

SELECT COALESCE(r.renew_reason, '未填写') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM company_service_renew r JOIN company_service cs ON cs.id = r.company_service_id AND cs.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted=0 AND r.renew_type=3 AND r.renew_end_date >= DATE(#{start}) AND r.renew_end_date < DATE(#{end}) AND cs.butler_owner_user IN #{x} GROUP BY r.renew_reason ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT s.owner_user AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, COUNT(*) AS total_steps, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS reject_rate FROM work_order_step s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=s.owner_user AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.update_time >= #{start} AND s.update_time < #{end} AND s.owner_user IN #{x} GROUP BY s.owner_user HAVING total_steps > 0 ORDER BY reject_rate DESC

SELECT t.username, u.real_name AS real_name, t.curr_amt AS current, t.prev_amt AS previous, t.yoy_amt AS yoy FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AS username, SUM(CASE WHEN w.complete_time >= #{currStart} AND w.complete_time < #{currEnd} THEN COALESCE(o.final_amount,0) ELSE 0 END) AS curr_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN w.complete_time >= #{prevStart} AND w.complete_time < #{prevEnd} THEN COALESCE(o.final_amount,0) ELSE 0 END) AS prev_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN w.complete_time >= #{yoyStart} AND w.complete_time < #{yoyEnd} THEN COALESCE(o.final_amount,0) ELSE 0 END) AS yoy_amt FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id=w.order_id AND o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.status='PAID' WHERE w.deleted=0 AND w.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND w.task_type='RENEWAL' AND w.status='DONE' AND w.complete_time IS NOT NULL
AND (w.current_owner_user IN #{x} OR (w.current_owner_user IS NULL AND w.owner_user IN #{x})) GROUP BY COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) ) t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=t.username AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status='DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done_count, COUNT(*) AS total_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status='DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS rate FROM work_order WHERE deleted=0 AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_type='RENEWAL' AND due_time IS NOT NULL AND due_time >= #{start} AND due_time < #{end}
AND (current_owner_user IN #{x} OR (current_owner_user IS NULL AND owner_user IN #{x}))

SELECT t.username, u.real_name AS real_name, t.curr_rate AS current, t.prev_rate AS previous FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AS username, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status='DONE' AND w.complete_time >= #{currStart} AND w.complete_time < #{currEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN w.due_time >= #{currStart} AND w.due_time < #{currEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS curr_rate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status='DONE' AND w.complete_time >= #{prevStart} AND w.complete_time < #{prevEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN w.due_time >= #{prevStart} AND w.due_time < #{prevEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS prev_rate FROM work_order w WHERE w.deleted=0 AND w.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND w.task_type='RENEWAL'
AND (w.current_owner_user IN #{x} OR (w.current_owner_user IS NULL AND w.owner_user IN #{x})) GROUP BY COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) ) t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=t.username AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(w.complete_time,'%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(o.final_amount),0) AS amount FROM work_order w JOIN orders o ON o.id=w.order_id AND o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.status='PAID' WHERE w.deleted=0 AND w.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND w.task_type='RENEWAL' AND w.status='DONE' AND w.complete_time >= #{start} AND w.complete_time < #{end}
AND (w.current_owner_user IN #{x} OR (w.current_owner_user IS NULL AND w.owner_user IN #{x})) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, DATE_FORMAT(w.complete_time,'%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(o.final_amount),0) AS amount FROM work_order w JOIN orders o ON o.id=w.order_id AND o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.status='PAID' LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 WHERE w.deleted=0 AND w.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND w.task_type='RENEWAL' AND w.status='DONE' AND w.complete_time >= #{start} AND w.complete_time < #{end}
AND (w.current_owner_user IN #{x} OR (w.current_owner_user IS NULL AND w.owner_user IN #{x})) GROUP BY COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user), month ORDER BY username, month

SELECT COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, SUM(CASE WHEN w.status='DONE' AND w.complete_time >= #{start} AND w.complete_time < #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done_count, SUM(CASE WHEN w.create_time >= #{start} AND w.create_time < #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status='DONE' AND w.complete_time >= #{start} AND w.complete_time < #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN w.create_time >= #{start} AND w.create_time < #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS rate FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 WHERE w.deleted=0 AND w.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND w.status NOT IN ('CANCELED','DRAFT')
AND (w.current_owner_user IN #{x} OR (w.current_owner_user IS NULL AND w.owner_user IN #{x})) GROUP BY COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) HAVING total_count > 0 ORDER BY rate DESC, done_count DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(complete_time,'%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, create_time, complete_time)) / 60.0, 2) AS amount FROM work_order WHERE deleted=0 AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status='DONE' AND complete_time IS NOT NULL AND create_time IS NOT NULL AND complete_time >= #{start} AND complete_time < #{end}
AND (current_owner_user IN #{x} OR (current_owner_user IS NULL AND owner_user IN #{x})) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT bsu.period AS month, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bsu.id IS NOT NULL THEN cs.company_id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT cs.company_id), 0), 2) AS amount FROM company_service cs LEFT JOIN company_bank_statement_upload bsu ON bsu.company_id=cs.company_id AND bsu.period IN #{p} AND (COALESCE(bsu.upload_count,0) > 0 OR COALESCE(bsu.no_statement,0)=1) WHERE cs.deleted=0 AND cs.butler_owner_user IN #{x} GROUP BY bsu.period ORDER BY bsu.period

SELECT t.username, u.real_name AS real_name, t.curr_count AS curr_count, t.prev_count AS prev_count FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AS username, SUM(CASE WHEN w.status='DONE' AND w.complete_time >= #{currStart} AND w.complete_time < #{currEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curr_count, SUM(CASE WHEN w.status='DONE' AND w.complete_time >= #{prevStart} AND w.complete_time < #{prevEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev_count FROM work_order w WHERE w.deleted=0 AND w.tenant_id=#{tenantId}
AND (w.current_owner_user IN #{x} OR (w.current_owner_user IS NULL AND w.owner_user IN #{x})) GROUP BY COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) ) t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=t.username AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS amount FROM work_order WHERE deleted=0 AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND (current_owner_user=#{username} OR owner_user=#{username}) AND create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(complete_time,'%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, create_time, complete_time)) / 60.0, 2) AS amount FROM work_order WHERE deleted=0 AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status='DONE' AND (current_owner_user=#{username} OR owner_user=#{username}) AND complete_time >= #{start} AND complete_time < #{end} GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(complete_time,'%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status='DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS amount FROM work_order WHERE deleted=0 AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_type='RENEWAL' AND (current_owner_user=#{username} OR owner_user=#{username}) AND complete_time >= #{start} AND complete_time < #{end} GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_steps, SUM(CASE WHEN status='REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status='REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS rate FROM work_order_step WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND owner_user=#{username} AND update_time >= #{start} AND update_time < #{end}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_order WHERE deleted=0 AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_type='RENEWAL' AND (current_owner_user=#{username} OR owner_user=#{username}) AND due_time IS NOT NULL AND due_time >= #{from} AND due_time < #{to}

SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, create_time, complete_time) < 4 THEN '4 小时内' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, create_time, complete_time) < 8 THEN '4-8 小时' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, create_time, complete_time) < 24 THEN '8-24 小时' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, create_time, complete_time) < 72 THEN '1-3 天' ELSE '3 天以上' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS count FROM work_order WHERE deleted=0 AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status='DONE' AND (current_owner_user=#{username} OR owner_user=#{username}) AND complete_time >= #{start} AND complete_time < #{end} GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY FIELD(bucket, '4 小时内','4-8 小时','8-24 小时','1-3 天','3 天以上')
